verdict.rationale: Script-tag, no-build usage is a fair question for a web UI framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Next.js can be loaded via a script tag. Its docs say it "automatically configures lower-level tools like bundlers and compilers," which points to a build-tool-driven workflow rather than script-tag usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the framework directly via a script tag without needing a package manager or bundler
